corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: Cover issue precision is January 2026 only; exact EMA publication supplies the date fallback. Joint EMA/FDA production is recorded in institutional and bibliographic authorship. The joint_institutional tag is not used because its published vocabulary requires more than one EU institution/body. FDA is a non-EU co-author, not an EU institution or external commissioned author. This review inspected the EMA manifestation and does not claim byte equivalence with the FDA PDF. Concept coding and policy-group assignment remain uncompleted; empty arrays do not establish absence.
